_doc: What every film must have before it is rendered (film_check.py <work> <films...>) and what the out folder must hold after (film_check.py <work> --out <out>). Each item: id, fmt (long | short | out), metric (a function in film_check.py), op (>= | <= | == | true), value, level (optional "warn": a miss prints WARN and does not fail), whole_film (optional true: a count or place over the whole film; WARN in a fragment test folder made by fragment.py, FRAGMENT.json), why (Kamil's words or a measured reference). A plan may skip an item only with a reason: "skip": {"<id>": "why not in this film"}. Thresholds are data: change them here, not in code. Reference numbers: render/ref/research/teardowns.md (Jeff Su, Ali Abdaal, Kuba Klawiter, Fireship, 2026-11-04).
